high_level_description: The image shows a single Nike Air Flight Lite Mid sneaker displayed on a shelf. The sneaker is predominantly black with white accents and features a distinctive design that includes a white swoosh logo on the side and a white Nike logo on the heel. The shoe has a mid-cut design, providing ankle support, and appears to be made of a combination of materials, including suede and synthetic leather. The sneaker is positioned in front of a red box with a label that provides product information. The label reads "AIR FLIGHT LITE MID" and specifies the colorway as "BLACK/WHITE-VARSITY RED.
